specialty_focus: Cardinal Health Canada is a national healthcare products and services distributor, serving hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and other healthcare providers across Canada. It specializes in distribution and logistics, with a focus on areas such as oncology, nuclear medicine, and infusion services. While it distributes medical devices, it is not specifically focused on wearable medical devices.
